trial_metadata.execution_note: This is a designed/comparative analysis of expected Factory Build Lite behavior based on P5/P7 trial validations and documented gate behaviors. Actual execution deferred to user or future phase.

design_phase.observation: Factory Bootstrap Gate enforces Project Expertise Flow: entity design, API outline, page tree, permission matrix before code. Factory.ps1 bootstrap validates 18/18 checks.
design_phase.advantage: Structured design reduces rework. Architecture decisions made upfront.

safety.observation: Security Gate scans for deploy traces, .env patterns, and secret-like content. Triggers blocking checks if deploy traces found.
safety.advantage: Automatic safety net. .env.production.example flagged. No secrets in output.

code_quality.observation: Test Repair Policy (CLASSIFICATION_FIRST) ensures tests are classified before modification. HONEST_SKIP for env-dependent tests.
code_quality.advantage: Consistent test policy. No fake passes. Clear documentation of why tests are skipped.

documentation.observation: Package QA Gate enforces manifest reconciliation, ZIP content audit, and 4-layer coverage check before handoff.
documentation.advantage: Guaranteed clean handoff. No missing files. SHA256 verified.

user_intervention.observation: Build Lite provides install→bootstrap→preflight→phase-close workflow. factory.ps1 guides each step.
user_intervention.advantage: Reduced cognitive burden. User follows structured phases instead of remembering all checks.
